The '''Burning Gear''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|flotilla]] part of the [[Ebruchi (fleet)|Ebruchi]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that included hundreds of [[Ebruchi]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and was [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ness (pirate)|Ness]] from [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Burning Gear]]''.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Burning Gear was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
